overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed the district's 2015 state accountability ratings, received reports on student programs and state budget proposals, and discussed declining enrollment at Minuteman Regional Technical High School. The committee also voted to schedule a subcommittee meeting on curriculum and approved a high school band field trip to Pennsylvania.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payroll
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the January 25, 2016 meeting, along with routine bill transfers and payroll.

items.title: Report on High School Automated Threat Call
items.summary: Superintendent Belson reported on a low-level automated threat received at Medford High School and announced an upcoming safety meeting with local officials on February 10.

items.title: Bloomberg Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Update
items.summary: Received an update on student initiatives, community projects, and upcoming symposiums sponsored by the Bloomberg Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility.

items.title: 2015 District and Schools Accountability Report
items.summary: Discussed the state's 2015 accountability ratings and changes to state measurement formulas that designated Roberts Elementary as Level 3, and approved a motion to schedule an Academic Affairs subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Report on Distracted Driving Program
items.summary: Received a report highlighting a student presentation and public awareness initiative regarding the dangers of distracted driving.

items.title: Report on Governor's FY2017 Proposed State Budget
items.summary: Reviewed Governor Baker's proposed state budget proposal and its potential impact on local Chapter 70 education aid, kindergarten grants, and charter school reimbursements.

items.title: Report on Minuteman Regional Technical High School
items.summary: Discussed declining Medford student enrollment at Minuteman Regional Technical High School and the financial implications of Minuteman's proposed capital building project.

items.title: New Business, Condolences, and Field Trip Approval
items.summary: Passed several condolence resolutions, requested an update on a crossing guard location, and approved an out-of-state field trip for the Medford High School band to Hershey, Pennsylvania.
